5786.title: Provider option rows overflow a bounded menu
5786.rootCauseOneLine: A centered non-wrapping reasoning row retains full intrinsic item widths inside an overflow-hidden 20rem menu, clipping provider-defined labels and entire choices.
5786.proposedFix: Choose a touch-accessible overflow interaction that preserves the bounded menu; automatic wrapping would reverse the explicitly tested single-row requirement.
5786.caveats: Real production component and CSS reproduced twice; no live provider, full picker drawer or iOS Safari reproduction. Test source and output are embedded inline. No fix PR because the required overflow interaction needs a product decision.
